awaken.source.awaken.beastbound_blade: Craft one at a crafting table. Every forged weapon of its tier starts from it.
awaken.source.awaken.deepglass_shard: Cut Deepglass with a diamond edge, where the Deep presses up below the surface.
awaken.source.awaken.dream_residue: The Lucidium: what a dream leaves behind when you wake from it.
awaken.source.awaken.essence_shard: Any awakened creature drops them, and so do rifts, hunts, gates and bounties.
awaken.source.awaken.gatewrought_blade: Craft one at a crafting table. Every forged weapon of its tier starts from it.
awaken.source.awaken.lord_heart: The Lord of a gate, when you defeat it.
awaken.source.awaken.lordscale_blade: Craft one at a crafting table. Every forged weapon of its tier starts from it.
awaken.source.awaken.precursor_alloy: Craft it from Precursor scrap and a Lord's Heart. Scrap comes from Precursor ruins.
awaken.source.awaken.precursor_circuit: Craft it from two Precursor scrap, two redstone and a copper ingot. Scrap comes from Precursor ruins.
awaken.source.awaken.sovereign_blade: Craft one at a crafting table. Every forged weapon of its tier starts from it.
awaken.source.awaken.starmetal_ingot: Smelt raw starmetal, cut from the core of a fallen star.
awaken.source.awaken.veilwoven_blade: Craft one at a crafting table. Every forged weapon of its tier starts from it.
awaken.source.awaken.wildhide_blade: Craft one at a crafting table. Every forged weapon of its tier starts from it.
awaken.source.blueprint: Hale's rack sells it for essence, a gate teaches it, and a Forge draws copies of one you know.
awaken.source.minecraft.amethyst_shard: Break amethyst clusters in geodes, deep underground.
awaken.source.minecraft.copper_ingot: Smelt raw copper from copper ore, found in caves and along rivers.
awaken.source.minecraft.diamond: Diamond ore, deep below the surface, and diamond lodes.
awaken.source.minecraft.echo_shard: Ancient cities, deep in the dark.
awaken.source.minecraft.gold_ingot: Smelt raw gold from gold ore, deep underground and in badlands.
awaken.source.minecraft.iron_ingot: Smelt raw iron from iron ore and iron lodes.
awaken.source.minecraft.moss_block: Moss patches in lush caves and forests.
awaken.source.minecraft.netherite_scrap: Smelt ancient debris from the Nether.
awaken.source.minecraft.phantom_membrane: Phantoms, which find you after several nights without sleep.
awaken.source.minecraft.quartz: Nether quartz ore, mostly in the Nether.
awaken.source.minecraft.turtle_scute: Baby turtles, when they grow up.
awaken.source.tag.hunter_bind_a: Diamonds, wind charges or Precursor circuits.
awaken.source.tag.hunter_bind_b: Echo shards, dream residue or ender pearls.
awaken.source.tag.hunter_bind_c: Gold ingots, emeralds or amethyst shards.
awaken.source.tag.hunter_bind_e: String from spiders, feathers from birds, moss blocks, or gel and wicks from creatures of the wilds.
awaken.source.tag.hunter_core_a: Parts from B-rank and A-rank Lords, and from the deep guardians.
awaken.source.tag.hunter_core_b: Parts from C-rank and B-rank Lords.
awaken.source.tag.hunter_core_c: A relic from a D-rank Lord.
awaken.source.tag.hunter_core_d: A trophy from a named beast (a Briar Tusk, a Wyrm Scale, an Antler Tine), or a part from an E-rank Lord.
awaken.source.tag.hunter_core_e: Bone from skeletons, flint from gravel, quartz from the Nether, or a horn, shell or crystal from creatures of the wilds.
awaken.source.tag.hunter_core_s: Parts from the Herald and the Hollow Court, and the Architect's Key.
awaken.source.tag.hunter_hide_a: Precursor alloy, netherite scrap or shulker shells.
awaken.source.tag.hunter_hide_c: Turtle or armadillo scutes, or phantom membrane.
awaken.source.tag.hunter_hide_d: Leather, turtle or armadillo scutes, phantom membrane, or the hides of creatures in the wilds.
awaken.source.tag.hunter_hide_e: Leather from cows and horses, rabbit hide from rabbits, phantom membrane from phantoms, and the hides of creatures in the wilds.
awaken.source.tag.hunter_hide_s: Starmetal ingots, cut from fallen stars.
awaken.source.tag.tier_metal_a: Netherite scrap, smelted from ancient debris in the Nether.
awaken.source.tag.tier_metal_b: Deepglass shards, cut with a diamond edge where the Deep presses up.
awaken.source.tag.tier_metal_c: Diamonds, from diamond ore and diamond lodes, deep below the surface.
awaken.source.tag.tier_metal_d: Iron ingots, smelted from iron ore and iron lodes.
awaken.source.tag.tier_metal_s: Starmetal ingots, smelted from raw starmetal cut from fallen stars.
awaken.style.axe.blurb: Wide, heavy cuts that break a guard.
awaken.style.chainblade.blurb: A blade on a chain: mid-range, and it pulls things in.
awaken.style.daggers.blurb: Fast and close. Quick strikes, and you hit hardest from behind.
awaken.style.gauntlets.blurb: Fists: strings of punches and counters.
awaken.style.greatblade.blurb: Slow two-handed cuts that don't flinch.
awaken.style.katana.blurb: Draw and cut. The guard is the sheath.
awaken.style.longsword.blurb: Balanced. Good at guarding and answering.
awaken.style.maul.blurb: Slow and heavy. Breaks armour and slams the ground.
awaken.style.precursor.blurb: An energy blade that changes length.
awaken.style.shieldblade.blurb: Blade and shield: block first, bash back.
awaken.style.spear.blurb: Long reach. Keep things off you and thrust.
awaken.style.warstaff.blurb: Each hit charges your power energy.
awaken.tooltip.blade.what: A short blade that fights like a sword. Every forged weapon is made from one.
awaken.tooltip.blueprint.found: Found in: %s-rank gates, level %s structures, villages of level %s.
awaken.tooltip.blueprint.hale: Hale sells it at %s-rank for %s essence.
awaken.tooltip.blueprint.what: A design. Put it in the crafting grid with a Hunter blade and parts. It comes back out when the weapon is made.
awaken.tooltip.essence.used: Used for: every forged piece, Blueprints and tempering.
awaken.tooltip.essence.what: What awakened creatures leave behind. Night hunters drop about one for every two kills, and gate monsters and bosses drop more.
awaken.tooltip.forge.attune: Sneak and use it with one of our weapons to attune it.
awaken.tooltip.forge.blueprint: Use it with an empty hand to open the Armoury and draw copies of Blueprints you know.
awaken.tooltip.forge.temper: Use it to temper a weapon or armour piece, or to see the Hearth's upgrades.
awaken.tooltip.ingredient: Hunter gear ingredient. Hold Shift for where it comes from.
awaken.tooltip.lord_forged: Dropped by %s in %sgates. Sometimes: it is certain by the third Lord without one.
awaken.tooltip.marked: Found, not forged: it drops from elites, Wardens, camp hearts and the Lords of gates.
